title: No kuras valsts? (Origins, family and free time)

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Sveika! Mani sauc Marta.

tokens.note: 3 pres.; mani sauc = I am called

sentences.natural: Hello! My name is Marta.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Sveika, Marta! Es esmu Emma. Prieks iepazīties!
sentences.natural: Hello, Marta! I'm Emma. Nice to meet you!

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Cik ilgi mums jārunā?
sentences.natural: How long do we have to talk?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Piecas minūtes.
sentences.natural: Five minutes.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Labi. Cik cilvēku ir mūsu klasē?
sentences.natural: Good. How many people are in our class?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Es domāju, deviņi vai desmit.
sentences.natural: I think, nine or ten.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Un cik latviešu?
sentences.natural: And how many Latvians?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Nulle!
sentences.natural: Zero!

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Haha, jā! Nulle latviešu latviešu klasē.
sentences.natural: Haha, yes! Zero Latvians in a Latvian class.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: No kuras valsts tu esi?
sentences.natural: Which country are you from?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Es esmu no Igaunijas. Un tu?
sentences.natural: I'm from Estonia. And you?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Es esmu no Lietuvas, bet tagad es dzīvoju Rīgā.
sentences.natural: I'm from Lithuania, but now I live in Riga.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Es arī! Kur tu dzīvo?
sentences.natural: Me too! Where do you live?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Es dzīvoju Vecrīgā. Un tu?
sentences.natural: I live in the Old Town. And you?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Es dzīvoju centrā. Vai tev patīk Rīga?
sentences.natural: I live in the centre. Do you like Riga?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Jā, ļoti. Rīga ir skaista pilsēta.
sentences.natural: Yes, very much. Riga is a beautiful city.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Jā, tā ir!
sentences.natural: Yes, it is!

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Kādas valodas tu runā?
sentences.natural: What languages do you speak?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Igauniski, somiski, angliski un mazliet latviski.
sentences.natural: Estonian, Finnish, English and a little Latvian.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Četras valodas! Oho! Es runāju lietuviski, poliski un latviski.
sentences.natural: Four languages! Wow! I speak Lithuanian, Polish and Latvian.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Trīs valodas — arī nav slikti! Ko tu dari Rīgā? Vai tu strādā?
sentences.natural: Three languages — not bad either! What do you do in Riga? Do you work?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Es strādāju kafejnīcā, sešas stundas, bet tikai trīs reizes nedēļā. Un tu?
sentences.natural: I work in a café, six hours, but only three times a week. And you?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Es strādāju veikalā. Astoņas stundas dienā.
sentences.natural: I work in a shop. Eight hours a day.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Astoņas stundas! Tas ir daudz.
sentences.natural: Eight hours! That's a lot.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Vai tev ir brāļi un māsas?
sentences.natural: Do you have brothers and sisters?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Jā, man ir brālis un māsa. Mēs esam pieci ģimenē.
sentences.natural: Yes, I have a brother and a sister. There are five of us in the family.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Mans brālis strādā Vācijā. Viņš ir ārsts.
sentences.natural: My brother works in Germany. He's a doctor.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Manai māsai ir septiņi gadi. Viņa vēl mācās skolā.
sentences.natural: My sister is seven years old. She's still at school.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Man nav brāļa, man ir tikai māsa. Mēs esam četri.
sentences.natural: I don't have a brother, only a sister. There are four of us.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Mana ģimene dzīvo Tallinā. Kur dzīvo tava ģimene?
sentences.natural: My family lives in Tallinn. Where does your family live?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Viļņā. Es viņus ļoti mīlu.
sentences.natural: In Vilnius. I love them very much.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Kāpēc tu mācies latviski?
sentences.natural: Why are you learning Latvian?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Man vajag. Veikalā klienti runā latviski. Un tu?
sentences.natural: I need to. In the shop the customers speak Latvian. And you?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Es mācos, jo es dzīvoju Latvijā un man ļoti patīk šī valsts.
sentences.natural: I'm learning because I live in Latvia, and I really like this country.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Haha, tu esi romantiķe!
sentences.natural: Haha, you're a romantic!

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.target: Varbūt, haha! Nu, jauka saruna!
sentences.natural: Maybe, haha! Well, nice conversation!

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.target: Tiešām! Tiekamies!
sentences.natural: Indeed! See you!
